Skid Steer/Trailer Combination – Sold AS IS, WHERE IS

This skid steer and trailer combination is being sold AS IS, WHERE IS. No guarantees or warranties are made regarding the condition, operability, or performance of either the skid steer or trailer. Buyers are responsible for conducting their own inspection prior to bidding.

New Holland LS150 Skid Steer

The New Holland LS150 was removed from service due to age. As demonstrated in the video, the unit starts, runs, and drives forward and in reverse. The hydraulic functions operate.

The battery currently requires a jump-start and may require replacement.

The skid steer includes:

  • One (1) 72-inch material bucket
  • One (1) grapple attachment, as shown in the photos
  • Engine HOURS - 3,795

Trailer

The trailer included with this lot is a 1998 REDI FSL12H+2S. The trailer was removed from service due to age and overall condition. Rust and corrosion are present.

The trailer was previously used to transport/tow the skid steer.
